Gavasad-3 adds 6,500 MVA by Apr-27 (Rs 90-120 Cr, internal accruals); enables 100 MVA / 220 kV; Rs 1,500 Cr potential by FY29-30.

bottom_line.breaks: US tariff passthrough fails + oil stays elevated — 29% OPM does not return, 34x compresses.
bottom_line.core: Not a commodity winder — export-approved 50 MVA / 132 kV specialist with 50.7% ROCE, debt-free.
bottom_line.changed: Domestic-led to export-led: 19% -> 48% export mix in five years; margins 11% -> 29%.
bottom_line.hidden: Watch OPM recovery, not dispatches — Q1 16.4% is the whole thesis in one number.
bottom_line.question: Does 29% OPM return by H2 FY27 as price revisions + backlog shipments flow through?
bottom_line.takeaway: Own the approvals, wait for the price — Rs 3,704 buy zone vs Rs 4,104.
